The '''Final Stage Energizer''' was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Galaxy Gun]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. It was bulbous construction at the end of the vast [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], immediately preceding the exist of the launch tube.<ref name="EGWT" />
